summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose modifications to its existing equity line of credit with Ascent Partners Fund LLC, announced in a prior Securities Purchase Agreement. Specifically, for May 2026 advance notices, the purchase price is set at 97% of the lowest VWAP over the prior ten trading days, with a $300,000 cap and a true-up mechanism that may require additional share issuance if the subsequent sale price is lower. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, special committee review, activist campaign, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is announced. This filing is a routine update to a financing arrangement and does not constitute a special situation. There are no deal terms to report.
